title: Hold an authority to generate or transmit electricity
what: Generate, transmit or distribute electricity only under a licence from the Regulator.

sources.title: Electricity Supply Industry Act 1995 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on operations in the electricity supply industry for which a licence is required unless the person holds a licence under this Act authorising the relevant operations

sources.title: Electricity Supply Industry Act 1995 (Tas)
sources.quote: The operations in the electricity supply industry for which a licence is required are – (a) generation of electricity; or (b) transmission of electricity; or (c) distribution of electricity

administration.who: Regulator appointed under the Electricity Supply Industry Act 1995 (Tas)
